decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a component technology that supports the whole infrared heater range, so without evidence of a shortfall against aspirations there is little cause for problemistic search to drop it.
It had a dedicated page in 2019, which signals it is central to the core gas infrared line, and the missing archive data after 2019 says nothing about poor results.
The luminous radiant heater fits the firm's established hall-heating niche and can be carried on existing slack, though its results remain uncertain.
This tube heater overlaps with Product F, which raises some risk of consolidating the range, but tube heaters are a core segment and nothing shows performance below aspiration.
The standard plaque heater is a volume product with its own page, so it likely meets aspirations as a staple of the portfolio.
Despite overlapping with Product D, the gas-fired tube heater serves demand for industrial hall heating, and rising gas prices in 2022 alone do not yet justify dropping it.
